rung_purposes.purpose: Initialize test thresholds and parameters
Check PT-2001 for wire break or under-range and set alarm
Check PT-2001 for overpressure condition and set alarm
Monitor for loss of supply air pressure during busy state
Reset fault flags when fault reset pushbutton is pressed
Aggregate faults and E-stop status to trigger general fault and activate beacon
Allow manual vent valve control when not in auto mode
Start auto cycle and reset result flags when pallet is present and ready
Advance from CLAMP to FILL when clamp is confirmed closed
Run fill step timeout timer
Trigger fill timeout alarm if fill timer completes
Advance from FILL to STABILISE when pack reaches target pressure
Run pressure stabilisation timer
Capture initial pack pressure into D110
Advance from STABILISE to TEST step
Run test window timer
Capture final pressure into D111 and calculate pressure drop
Evaluate pressure drop against limit to determine PASS or FAIL result
Advance from TEST to VENT step when test completes
Abort sequence to VENT and set FAIL result on general fault
Run vent timer
Advance from VENT to UNCLAMP when vent timer done and pressure is safe
Advance from UNCLAMP to DONE when clamp is fully open
Reset busy flag and clear DONE step when pallet leaves test position
Energize clamp close solenoid during active cycle steps
Energize fill valve during FILL step unless faulted
Energize vent valve during VENT step or upon overpressure fault
Output PASS or FAIL signals to line controller when DONE
End of program execution
